title: Compute temperature-dependent Sellmeier coefficients
action: Using the quadratic temperature relationships a_i(T)=a_i0 + a_i1*T + a_i2*T^2 and b_i(T)=b_i0 + b_i1*T + b_i2*T^2 with the Matsuoka coefficients provided in the instruction, calculate a_i and b_i for i=1,2,3 at T=20°C and T=40°C. Write the results to sellmeier_coefficients.csv.
description: Compute Sellmeier coefficients at two temperatures from the publicly provided Matsuoka parameterization.
output_schema: CSV with a header row and exactly 6 data rows. Columns: temperature (integer, 20 or 40), i (integer, 1, 2, or 3), a_i (float), b_i (float).
